items.title: Add ProofStory guidance to active reviewer prompts and story_review advisory rendering
items.context: Covers M0/M3/M8 gaps: active prompts must name ProofStory review responsibilities, and story_review should show ProofStory advisory diagnostics before DEV.
items.userSees: User sees ProofStory advisory rows in story_review output and reviewer prompt text tells active reviewers how to audit ProofStory obligations.

happy.desc: story_review reports ProofStory advisory diagnostics for a story with missing triggered ProofStory artifacts

edge.desc: Reviewer prompt updates remain English and do not claim prompt-only evidence can satisfy gates

adversarial.desc: If prompts promise a ProofStory review obligation, process-fact contract proves corresponding CLI/gate support exists

items.title: Add ledger assignment fields for parent and child story slicing
items.context: Covers M1 gap: milestone ledger rows need optional parent ledger / assigned story fields without forcing one milestone to become one story.
items.userSees: User sees milestone ledger rows expose optional parent/assigned-story fields without auto-splitting the story.

happy.desc: milestone_ledger_set/add accept optional parentLedgerId and assignedStory fields and preserve them in get output

edge.desc: milestones without assignedStory remain valid and do not force one milestone to become one story

adversarial.desc: invalid parent/assigned-story fields fail validation before corrupting milestone-ledger.json

items.title: Implement slice-plan artifact and oversized ledger exception semantics
items.context: Covers M4/M9 gaps: oversized ledgers need an auditable slice plan or child-story assignment path before DEV in enforce mode.
items.userSees: User sees oversized ledger diagnostics accept an explicit slice plan or child-story assignment instead of always blocking enforce mode.

happy.desc: slice-plan artifact covers oversized ledger rows and clears enforce-mode oversized ledger blocking when complete

edge.desc: too_broad diagnostics still produce suggested slices and do not auto-create child stories

adversarial.desc: incomplete or stale slice plan does not bypass the oversized ledger gate

items.title: Implement parent ledger roll-up checks for child-story coverage
items.context: Covers M5 gap: parent stories must be able to verify child stories and ledger rows before DONE once slice plans exist.
items.userSees: User sees parent ledger roll-up diagnostics prove required child stories and ledger rows are covered before parent DONE.

happy.desc: parent roll-up artifact with all required child stories and milestones covered passes DONE equivalence

edge.desc: parent roll-up is optional when no slice plan or parent ledger exists

adversarial.desc: missing required child story coverage keeps parent DONE equivalence blocking in enforce mode

items.title: Implement lightweight single-outcome DONE equivalence
items.context: Covers M5 gap: ordinary single-outcome stories should compare summary/delivery against the original snapshot instead of requiring a confirmed milestone ledger.
items.userSees: User sees ordinary single-outcome DONE equivalence pass through a lightweight snapshot-to-summary check without needing a milestone ledger.

happy.desc: single-outcome story with original snapshot and delivery summary passes lightweight DONE equivalence without confirmed ledger

edge.desc: milestone or high-assurance story still uses strict ledger-based DONE equivalence

adversarial.desc: DONE summary that is narrower than the snapshot remains blocked unless user-confirmed shrinkage exists

items.title: Bind red evidence to baseline head/material and green relation
items.context: Covers M6 gap: red evidence must carry baseline freshness and the transition relation to current green evidence.
items.userSees: User sees red evidence records include baseline head/material binding and an explicit relation to current green evidence.

happy.desc: red_evidence_create stores baseline head/material and green relation fields and diagnostics consume them

edge.desc: docs-only stories still do not require red evidence

adversarial.desc: red evidence for the wrong acceptance criterion or stale baseline cannot satisfy triggered red evidence diagnostics

items.title: Add spike disposable-code policy checks
items.context: Covers M7 gap: spike evidence must not silently carry disposable code into implementation; promotion remains explicit and auditable.
items.userSees: User sees spike diagnostics flag disposable spike code until it is discarded or explicitly promoted through auditable semantics.

happy.desc: spike records can mark disposable code paths and resolved/discarded/promoted status is audited

edge.desc: resolved investigation evidence still does not automatically count as red or verification evidence

adversarial.desc: active disposable spike code blocks ProofStory gate in enforce mode until discarded or explicitly promoted

items.title: Close risk-adaptive high-assurance review policy behavior
items.context: Covers M8/M9 gap: high-assurance ProofStory must expose stronger review/completeness policy diagnostics while keeping existing reviewer evidence fresh and reviewRunId-bound.
